title: feat(spec): InlineActionSchema picks `description`, so an inline action's param dialog can say what it does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9X2jU4uniTTvc92oRkTrTKD)_
Fixes #29248

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` file and no hand-written `content/docs` page lists the inline action's key set; the only lists are the generated `content/docs/references/ui/{action,component}.mdx` tables, regenerated here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：页面上内联声明的动作（`element:button` 的 `properties.action`）现在可以写 `description`，即参数对话框标题下那行说明；同时 `os validate` / 发布门对它的检查与已注册动作一致。
- 为什么改：您在 cloud#3281 裁定 A，先放宽上游契约。「邀请成员」对话框现在只显示通用提示，说不清邀请会发生什么；没有这个键，云端无从写这句话。
- 风险与回滚：纯放宽，旧元数据全部照常通过；只多接受一个键，其余未选的键（`icon`、`variant`、`body`、`cancelText`、`submitText`）仍被拒。已知缺口：控制台尚未把内联的多语言 map 折成当前语言，等 UI 半张卡落地。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`（`InlineActionSchema` 的 pick 与上方注释）、`packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`（`INLINE_KEYS`）、`packages/spec/src/ui/inline-action.test.ts`（新用例与对照组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/inline-action.test.ts`，预期全部通过，含「`description` says what the action does」一组 10 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`: `InlineActionSchema`'s `.pick({…})` gains `description: true`. It is `ActionSchema`'s own field (the `template` slot with the inline locale-map arm), so the describe text, the parse and the refusals are shared, not restated. The derived `InlineAction` / `InlineActionParsed` types follow from the pick.
- The schema's docblock records why: the `element:button` renderer's forward list (`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`) already passes `action.description` to the runner, and the console's param-collection handler (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`) draws it under the dialog title. It also states the one window that remains: the inline copy localizer (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useActionTextLocalizer.ts`) collapses only `confirmText`, `successMessage` and `errorMessage` (its `DECLARED_COPY_KEYS`), so an inline locale map on `description` reaches the dialog unresolved until #29249 lands. Spec accepts ahead of the renderer, never the reverse.
- Same docblock, in place: the `bodyExtra` paragraph said the forward list "does not yet include `bodyExtra`". Measured false on main `27c1c555` (`elements.tsx` forwards `bodyExtra: action.bodyExtra`), so it now says that window closed. Comment only.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts` (own commit; the seat added it to the claim's file surface): `INLINE_KEYS` gains `description`, and the two comments that said the inline pick has no `description` are corrected. Without this, an inline `description` with a `${…}` token, a hole over an unbound root or a blank text parses (the slot keeps its blank arm, as on a registered action) and would pass `objectstack validate`, `compile` and the publish gate, while the same text on a registered action is an error there. The describe text that renders into the InlineAction reference table says those doors name it, so leaving lint alone would ship declared ≠ enforced.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` and `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` (one `description` row each in the InlineAction tables), `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json` (`ui/InlineAction:description`).
- `.changeset/29248-inline-action-description.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/lint`, minor.
- Not touched, per the card: `ui/**` (#29249) and cloud. `cancelText` and `submitText` are not picked (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

Forced edits (they pinned the old pick):
- `packages/spec/src/ui/inline-action.test.ts` `INLINE_FIELDS` gains `'description'` ("admits exactly the documented field set"), and the "admits only fields ActionSchema itself declares" body gains a `description` so the round-trip covers it.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-description.test.ts` "an INLINE action still refuses it" pinned the refusal this card removes. It now asserts the inline parse keeps the description as its template envelope; the file header no longer lists "widen the INLINE surface" among what the key's change must not do.

New:
- `inline-action.test.ts` "InlineActionSchema — `description` says what the action does" (10 cases): a plain string parses and is kept as the `template` envelope; a locale map is kept verbatim; no `description` still parses and adds none; a non-string value is refused inline at the same path with the same code as on `ActionSchema`; `ElementButtonPropsSchema` carries it to parse output; CONTROL: `icon`, `variant`, `body`, `cancelText`, `submitText` are each still `unrecognized_keys`, naming exactly that key.
- `inline-action-type.test.ts`: two bodies typed through `InlineAction` carry `description` (locale map, plain string), compiled by the package typecheck and parsed by the door.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`: an inline `properties.action` `description` is judged like a registered one (a `${…}` token, a `${…}` inside a locale-map value at `description.zh-CN`, a blank sentence and a `{{ result.* }}` hole are each one error; a bound `{{ record.* }}` hole and a clean locale map draw nothing); and the page publish gate answers an inline `${…}` description with one error and no advisory.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise, measured on main `27c1c555` with the spec dist built from it: an inline `description` was REFUSED, not stripped. `InlineActionSchema.safeParse({ type: 'api', target: 'invite_user', description: 'Sends an e-mail invitation.' })` answered `unrecognized_keys` with `keys: ["description"]`, for the plain string and the locale map alike. So nothing an author wrote was silently lost; a page that declared it failed validation. On the head the same calls parse and keep it (string → `{ dialect: 'template', source }`, map verbatim).
- The console's param dialog also draws `submitText` and `cancelText` (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`). Neither is picked by `InlineActionSchema` nor forwarded by `element:button`, so an inline action cannot set the dialog's button labels. Nothing is declared that is not read, so this is no defect; noted for whoever widens the inline dialog copy next.
- The inline refusal of `body` prints "Did you mean `body` → `mode`?": the suggestion list is computed from `ActionSchema`'s full shape, and `mode` is not on the inline pick either, so following it draws a second refusal. Loud, not silent; noted only.
- `ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` reads the inline owed set from the built spec: `element:button` now owes 13 (was 12) and still forwards all of them, exit 0.

## Verification

Final head `7b596699`. The full suites ran at `89985489`; the only commit after it moves one spec test into its own `describe` (test file only), so the three touched spec test files, the spec typecheck and all gates were re-run on `7b596699`.

<details><summary>Spec, lint and ui consumers</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at `89985489`: Test Files 790 passed (790), Tests 23392 passed, 1 todo. At `7b596699`: `inline-action.test.ts`, `action-description.test.ts`, `inline-action-type.test.ts` 3/3 files, 60/60 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exit 0 at `89985489` and at `7b596699` (it compiles `inline-action-type.test.ts`, so the two `description` bodies typed as `InlineAction` are judged by tsc).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` at `89985489`: Test Files 189 passed (189), Tests 7827 passed, 5 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` exit 0.
- ui consumers that parse or forward an inline action, run from `ui/` against the rebuilt spec dist: `elementButtonActionMembers-8071`, `action-bodyShape-forward`, `action-onSuccess-forward`, `action-outcomeMessages-forward-11344`, `action-undeclared-keys-8648`, `block-config`, `block-config-i18n`, `PageBlockInspector.i18n`: 8/8 files, 126 tests passed. (The first run of `PageBlockInspector.i18n` could not resolve `@objectstack/lint` before lint's own dist was built; re-run after the build, 22/22.) The full ui suites are left to CI's Test UI.
- `node ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs` exit 0: `element:button owes 13, forwards 18` (was 12 on main); `check-component-surface-parity.mjs` report-only, exit 0.
- `packages/metadata*`: no fixture pins the inline key set (`git grep` for `InlineAction` and the pick's key list outside spec, lint and ui finds none), so nothing to run there.

</details>

<details><summary>Reverse verification</summary>

Both through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, blob restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after each):
- Drop `description: true,` from the pick → `inline-action.test.ts`, `action-description.test.ts`, `inline-action-type.test.ts`: 8 failed, 52 passed. Red: the field-set pin, the plain-string, locale-map, same-refusal and `element:button` cases, the flipped inline pin, and both typed bodies' runtime half. The five CONTROL rows and "still parses without one" stay green, as they should.
- Drop `'description'` from lint's `INLINE_KEYS` → `validate-action-copy-templates.test.ts`: 2 failed, 23 passed (exactly the two new inline-description cases).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates and generated artifacts</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` + `check:generated` at `89985489`: 1 of 14 stale (`check:docs`), regenerated with `--fix` and committed; then 14/14 up to date. At `7b596699`, after a rebuild: `check:generated` exit 0, no tracked file moved.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 103 derived, the same list at both heads. On `7b596699`: 103 run, every exit 0, `--ran` reconciliation "103 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". Seven dist-reading spec gates first answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: the dist predated the moved test file) and were re-run after the spec rebuild, exit 0 each. On `89985489` the same 103 also all exited 0.
- `check-changeset-no-major --event` on this body: exit 0, LEVEL AXIS reads `yes (widening)` + `added`, no package graded `patch`. `check-partof-closing-keyword` on this body: exit 0.
- Local-only: `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0. `check:dev-prereqs` exit 1: 35 `ui/` workspace packages have no `dist/` in this container (only `packages/**` was built); the spec dist is fresh. A local state reading, not a finding about this diff.
- Dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

</details>
